quotes: On June 12, 2026, we received a notice letter relating to an ANDA that was submitted to the U.S. FDA by Alkem Laboratories Ltd., or Alkem.

material_events.claim: Ironwood and AbbVie sued Alkem for patent infringement, which triggered an automatic stay of FDA approval of the ANDAs.
quotes: In response to Alkem’s notice letter, we and AbbVie filed a lawsuit against Alkem in the U.S. District Court for the District of New Jersey in July 2026.

material_events.claim: AstraZeneca assigned all of its rights and obligations under the China linaclotide collaboration agreement to Grand Life Sciences.
quotes: In May 2026, AstraZeneca AB, our former partner in China (including Hong Kong and Macau), notified us that it assigned all its rights and obligations under the collaboration agreement to Grand Life Sciences.

material_events.basis: stated in the 10-Q MD&A (P4) and the earnings release (P6)
material_events.claim: Ironwood initiated the confirmatory Phase III STARS-2 trial of apraglutide and is actively recruiting patients.
quotes: In June 2026, we initiated STARS-2 and are actively recruiting patients.

material_events.claim: The U.S. FDA approved LINZESS for pediatric patients ages 2-5 years-old with FC.
quotes: In June 2023 and May 2026, the U.S. FDA approved LINZESS as a once-daily treatment for pediatric patients ages 6-17 years-old and 2-5 years-old with FC, respectively, making LINZESS the first and only U.S. FDA-approved prescription therapy for FC in this patient population.

material_events.claim: Ironwood and AbbVie lowered the LINZESS list price; the company says this eliminated the inflationary component of statutory rebates.
quotes: Also, effective January 1, 2026, we and our partner, AbbVie, lowered the LINZESS list price in response to evolving health care dynamics and to support ongoing patient access.
Due to the decrease in the list price of LINZESS, the inflationary component of statutory required rebates across channels, including Medicaid, has been eliminated.

material_events.claim: HHS released a Maximum Fair Price for LINZESS of $136 for a 30-day equivalent supply, which becomes the new Medicare net price at the start of 2027.
quotes: The MFP for a 30-day equivalent supply of LINZESS, which will become the new Medicare net price as of January 1, 2027, is set to $136.

material_events.basis: stated in the 10-K MD&A (P3) and the income statement (F2)
material_events.claim: Ironwood carried out workforce reductions of mainly field-based sales staff and of positions supporting apraglutide commercialization; net restructuring was 20,509 (table in thousands) for the nine months to Sep. 30, 2025 and (40) (table in thousands) for the same period of 2026.
quotes: Restructuring expenses pertain to a workforce reduction initiative in connection with the VectivBio Acquisition, as well as workforce reductions in January 2025 consisting primarily of field-based sales employees and August 2025 consisting of certain positions supporting apraglutide commercialization efforts.

material_events.claim: Ironwood announced that, after discussions with the FDA, a confirmatory Phase III trial is needed before it can seek NDA approval for apraglutide.
quotes: In April 2025, we announced that, based on discussions with the U.S. FDA, a confirmatory Phase III clinical trial is needed to seek approval of a new drug application or NDA, for apraglutide for patients with SBS-IF who are dependent on PS.

material_events.claim: Ironwood decided to stop developing IW-3300 for IC/BPS after analysing its Phase II data.
quotes: In April 2025, based on analysis of the Phase II data, we decided to cease developing IW-3300 for IC/BPS.

material_events.claim: The FDA granted Ironwood pediatric exclusivity for linaclotide and approved LINZESS for pediatric patients 7 years of age and older with IBS-C.
quotes: On October 15, 2025, the U.S. FDA granted us a pediatric exclusivity for studies conducted on linaclotide, and in November 2025, approved LINZESS for pediatric patients 7 years of age and older with IBS-C.

risks.basis: stated in P1 and P2; counter stated in P6
risks.claim: Revenue is concentrated in U.S. LINZESS. The U.S. was 97.7% of 2025 total revenue, and linaclotide partnerships made up substantially all revenue.
quotes: We are highly dependent on the commercial success of LINZESS (linaclotide) in the U.S. for the foreseeable future.
Revenue attributable to our linaclotide partnerships comprised substantially all of our revenue for each of the years indicated.

risks.basis: stated in P1 and P2; the size of the revenue effect is not stated
risks.claim: LINZESS was selected for Medicare price negotiation under the IRA, with a Maximum Fair Price of $136 for a 30-day equivalent supply.
quotes: The MFP for a 30-day equivalent supply of LINZESS, which will become the new Medicare net price as of January 1, 2027, is set to $136.
The revised MFP for LINZESS was in line with our expectations.

risks.claim: Generic filer Alkem submitted an ANDA asserting that the LINZESS Orange Book patents are invalid, unenforceable or not infringed. Ironwood and AbbVie have sued Alkem.
quotes: In response to Alkem’s notice letter, we and AbbVie filed a lawsuit against Alkem in the U.S. District Court for the District of New Jersey in July 2026.
We have previously entered into settlement agreement with five of these filers.

risks.basis: stated in P2, P4 and P6
risks.claim: Apraglutide needs a confirmatory Phase III trial, STARS-2, before an NDA can be sought. Filing is planned only subject to STARS-2 results.
quotes: It is possible that the confirmatory Phase III clinical trial may not be considered sufficient by the U.S. FDA to approve our NDA, which could further delay a regulatory approval or may require us to expend more resources than we have available.
Subject to the results of STARS-2, we plan to file for regulatory approval in 2029.

risks.basis: figures stated in F1, F3 and P6; the liquidity risk is inferred from them
risks.claim: At the latest quarter-end, cash was 86,376 against a revolving credit facility balance of 325,000 (table in thousands), and total stockholders' deficit was (97,193).
quotes: Ironwood repaid $60.0 million on the revolving credit facility during the third quarter of 2026, reducing the outstanding principal balance to $325.0 million as of September 30, 2026, with $225.0 million of remaining borrowing capacity available under the facility.

risks.claim: Collaboration revenue depends on AbbVie-reported figures and estimates such as gross-to-net rebate reserves, which can be adjusted in later periods.
quotes: If we do not receive timely and accurate information or incorrectly estimate activity levels associated with the collaboration at a given point in time, we could be required to record adjustments in future periods.
low single-digit net price decline due to unfavorable gross-to-net rebate reserves

risks.basis: assumption stated in P6; revision risk inferred
risks.claim: The raised adjusted EBITDA guidance of >$350 million assumes no material business development expenses this year.
quotes: For purposes of this guidance, we have assumed that Ironwood will not incur material expenses related to business development activities in 2026.

risks.basis: stated in P7; the operational effect is inferred
risks.claim: The CEO is retiring, and the Chief Commercial Officer will succeed him.
quotes: Mr. McCourt will continue to serve as a director on the Board following his retirement as Chief Executive Officer.

risks.basis: stated in P4 and P1; the effect is inferred
risks.claim: AstraZeneca assigned its China linaclotide collaboration rights and obligations to Grand Life Sciences. Rest of world was 2.3% of 2025 revenue.
quotes: In May 2026, AstraZeneca AB, our former partner in China (including Hong Kong and Macau), notified us that it assigned all its rights and obligations under the collaboration agreement to Grand Life Sciences.

risks.basis: inferred from F1 balances and P6 description
risks.claim: Deferred tax assets fell from 103,433 to 48,935 (table in thousands). Income tax expense has been mostly non-cash because net operating losses and tax credits are being used.
quotes: Ironwood recorded $27.8 million of income tax expense in the third quarter of 2026, the majority of which was non-cash, as Ironwood continues to utilize net operating losses and tax credits to offset taxable income for federal purposes and in certain states.

unresolved_questions.basis: The MFP and its effective date are stated in P1 and P2. The revenue impact is not quantified in any item.
unresolved_questions.claim: How much will the LINZESS Medicare Maximum Fair Price of $136 reduce U.S. LINZESS net sales and Ironwood's collaborative arrangements revenue once it takes effect?
quotes: The MFP for a 30-day equivalent supply of LINZESS, which will become the new Medicare net price as of January 1, 2027, is set to $136.

unresolved_questions.basis: The stay and the lawsuit are stated in P5. The outcome is unknown.
unresolved_questions.claim: Will the Alkem Paragraph IV litigation end in a settlement, a win or a loss, and when could Alkem's generic linaclotide reach the market?
quotes: In accordance with the Hatch-Waxman Act, the timely filing of the lawsuit against Alkem with respect to the challenged patents triggered an automatic stay of the U.S. FDA’s approval of the ANDAs until up to December 12, 2028 (unless there is a court decision adverse to us and AbbVie sooner).

unresolved_questions.basis: P5 states that the settlements exist. Their terms are not in the evidence.
unresolved_questions.claim: On what dates do the five earlier ANDA settlements allow generic LINZESS to launch?
quotes: We have previously entered into settlement agreement with five of these filers.

unresolved_questions.basis: The plan and the site targets are stated in P4 and P6. Enrolment progress and results are not disclosed.
unresolved_questions.claim: Will STARS-2 enrol on schedule and produce positive results, so that the planned regulatory filing for apraglutide happens in 2029?
quotes: Subject to the results of STARS-2, we plan to file for regulatory approval in 2029.
The planned activation of more than 100 sites in 22 countries is on track.

unresolved_questions.basis: Inferred from a mismatch between the release wording and the 10-Q's nine-month cash flow statement.
unresolved_questions.claim: Is the $130.8 million of cash from operations that the release attributes to the third quarter actually a quarterly figure, when the 10-Q shows 130,798 (table in thousands) for the nine months?
quotes: Ironwood generated $130.8 million in cash from operations in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $47.6 million in cash from operations in the third quarter of 2025.

unresolved_questions.basis: Inferred from the balance sheet and the cash flow statement. No item explains the change.
unresolved_questions.claim: What caused accounts receivable to rise from 46,745 to 132,719 (table in thousands), and when will it be collected from AbbVie?

unresolved_questions.basis: Stated in P6 and P2. The full-year outcome is unknown.
unresolved_questions.claim: Will full-year LINZESS results meet the raised guidance driven by net price, given that third-quarter net price declined after reserve adjustments and the list price was cut?
quotes: Q3 2026 LINZESS U.S. net sales growth year-over-year was driven by 4.9% demand growth and low single-digit net price decline due to unfavorable gross-to-net rebate reserves in the third quarter of 2026 relative to 2025.
As an example, effective January 1, 2026, the LINZESS list price has been lowered in response to evolving health care dynamics and to support ongoing patient access.

unresolved_questions.basis: Inferred from the decline in the balance sheet figure and the release statement. The remaining NOL balance is not given.
unresolved_questions.claim: When will net operating losses and tax credits run out, so that income tax expense becomes largely cash, as deferred tax assets fall from 103,433 to 48,935 (table in thousands)?
quotes: Ironwood recorded $27.8 million of income tax expense in the third quarter of 2026, the majority of which was non-cash, as Ironwood continues to utilize net operating losses and tax credits to offset taxable income for federal purposes and in certain states.

unresolved_questions.basis: The balance is stated in P6 and F1. The terms are not in the evidence.
unresolved_questions.claim: What are the maturity, interest terms and covenants of the revolving credit facility, and how quickly will the remaining $325.0 million be repaid?
quotes: Ironwood repaid $60.0 million on the revolving credit facility during the third quarter of 2026, reducing the outstanding principal balance to $325.0 million as of September 30, 2026, with $225.0 million of remaining borrowing capacity available under the facility.

unresolved_questions.basis: The assignment is stated in P4. Its effect on terms is not disclosed.
unresolved_questions.claim: Do the milestone and royalty terms for linaclotide in China stay the same now that the agreement has been assigned to Grand Life Sciences?
quotes: In May 2026, AstraZeneca AB, our former partner in China (including Hong Kong and Macau), notified us that it assigned all its rights and obligations under the collaboration agreement to Grand Life Sciences.

unresolved_questions.basis: Stated in P7 as not yet determined.
unresolved_questions.claim: What performance metrics and period will the incoming CEO's PSUs use?
quotes: The vesting terms and performance period of the PSUs are expected to be determined in 2027.
